_notes.purpose: Named option vocabulary for every cascade decision in the campaign system. Defines the option pool each role can choose from during their cascade window. Most roles have a fixed set of 3 options. The Watch Master is the exception — see wm_selection below.
_notes.weight_matrix: This file defines WHAT the options are. HOW they compose (weights from upstream choices + chapter doctrine) is defined in cascade_weights.json (to be authored).
_notes.scope_principle: HC specialists set theatre-wide doctrine — their pick is an ORDER that flows down to the company specialist in the same domain and shapes that specialist's weighted menu. Company specialists make tactical decisions within that order. Each role has its own section and vocabulary; no two roles share options.
_notes.tags: Each option has a tags list. Tags drive strat pool weighting in the weight matrix. Tag vocabulary is defined in _tag_vocabulary below.
_notes.option_key_format: snake_case strings. Used in campaign_state.json cascade submissions.
_notes.track_map: Each role maps to its own section key — see _track_map at bottom. Influence flow (which HC specialist shapes which company specialist) is in rank_mappings.json influence_sources.track.
_notes.battle_line_note: Battle-line personal focus is always 2 options. The SAME 2 options are always presented; their relative weights shift based on Watch Sergeant doctrine. See personal_focus section.
_notes.kt_champion_note: Kill Team Champion does not have a named option vocabulary — they submit a mission_id directly plus an optional terminus_call. No cascade_options entry needed.
_notes.huntmaster_note: Huntmaster has no Company-tier equivalent. hunt_priority is HC-only.
_notes.wm_selection: The Watch Master's 3 presented options are not fixed — they are drawn from a pool of 8 theatre postures and vary each beat. Selection algorithm: (1) score every posture against the beat's scenario dominant_tags at 1.5x weight and the WM's home chapter doctrine_affinity tags at 1.0x weight; (2) rank postures by score; (3) take the top 3 provided no two share the same primary tag (first tag in their list) — if a conflict exists, replace the lower-scoring duplicate with the next-highest non-conflicting posture. Result: WM always sees exactly 3 options, always meaningfully distinct, always relevant to the scenario and his chapter. The watch_master section defines the full pool; _presented_count tells the bot how many to show.
_notes.wm_narrative_framing: Narratively, the WM's options represent the intelligence brief assembled by Ordo Xenos assets operating in the Reach — inquisitors, agents, and Watch Station auguries — filtered through the WM's own chapter traditions. A Watch Master from the Ultramarines sees opportunity where a Space Wolf sees prey. The bot makes that real.
_notes.backburner_character_death: TABLED. Concept: opt-in Oath of Martyrdom flag at enlistment. Triggers Fallen state for one beat on Omega + YOLO + full wipe. KT takes prestige hit. Brother returns from Apothecarion next beat. Name recorded on Roll of Honour. No studs lost. Not being implemented now — revisit after campaign system is live and stable.

_tag_vocabulary.defensive: Favors holding, resilience, fortification, area-denial strats.
_tag_vocabulary.terminus: Elevates terminus engagement strats and kill-scoring modifiers.
_tag_vocabulary.elimination: Precise, targeted killing — assassination, decapitation, single-threat focus.
_tag_vocabulary.stealth: Covert, surgical, low-footprint approaches. Denies enemy reaction.
_tag_vocabulary.tech: Machine spirits, engineering, weapons systems, field logistics.
_tag_vocabulary.faith: Litanies, oaths, spiritual endurance, Chaplaincy rites.
_tag_vocabulary.resilience: Endurance, recovery, sustainability — keeping the force fighting.
_tag_vocabulary.recovery: Asset recovery — gene-seed, relics, extracted personnel, hostile tech.
_tag_vocabulary.suppression: Area denial, forcing enemy posture changes, suppression economy.
_tag_vocabulary.fortify: Position hardening, securing gains, denying enemy recapture.

watch_master._description: The Watch Master's strategic posture for the beat — shapes the entire cascade tree below. Drawn from the pool below; 3 options presented per beat based on scenario tags and WM's chapter doctrine. See _notes.wm_selection for algorithm.

advance_the_spear.name: Advance the Spear
advance_the_spear.description: Push outward. The Watch expands its presence, relieves pressure on contested nodes, and drives the enemy from initiative. The kill teams are the spearpoint.

iron_vigil.name: Iron Vigil
iron_vigil.description: Hold ground. The Watch does not yield — fortify the committed node, resist the tide of pressure, deny the enemy any momentum. Resilience is the weapon.

scour_the_reach.name: Scour the Reach
scour_the_reach.description: Hunt what hides. Intelligence-led operations, void-theatre awareness, warp-threat identification. The enemy's secrets are more dangerous than its soldiers.

sanctify_the_ground.name: Sanctify the Ground
sanctify_the_ground.description: The Watch fights as a consecrated force. Faith and resilience are the doctrine — sacred ground is not surrendered, and the brothers stand together or not at all.

sever_the_cord.name: Sever the Cord
sever_the_cord.description: Remove what commands the enemy. One precise operation — the head comes off and the body follows. Intelligence drives the blade.

deny_the_tide.name: Deny the Tide
deny_the_tide.description: The Watch does not chase. It holds and grinds. Every wave that breaks on the kill teams is a wave that does not reach the sector. Suppression and endurance, nothing more.

void_interdiction.name: Void Interdiction
void_interdiction.description: The theatre is not the ground — it is the warp and the void between. Hunt what no baseline force can track. The Watch knows the enemy's nature. Act on it.

reclaim_the_reach.name: Reclaim the Reach
reclaim_the_reach.description: What was lost can be recovered. Gene-seed, relics, positions — the Watch takes back what the enemy presumed was theirs. Forward momentum, but toward what matters.

burn_the_ground.name: Burn the Ground
burn_the_ground.description: Deny the enemy any advantage from held terrain. What cannot be claimed by the Watch is destroyed — the Huntmaster does not permit the enemy to inherit a useful battlefield.

strike_and_withdraw.name: Strike and Withdraw
strike_and_withdraw.description: Hit fast, extract before commitment, strike again from a different angle. Tempo is the weapon — kill teams never become the fixed point the enemy can mass against.

lay_the_ambush.name: Lay the Ambush
lay_the_ambush.description: The Watch does not reveal itself until the moment is perfect. Intelligence gathers, positions are set, kill teams wait — the enemy walks into ground that has already been prepared for their death.

claim_the_high_ground.name: Claim the High Ground
claim_the_high_ground.description: Strategic position secured before operations begin. The Watch chooses the terrain and the enemy must come to it — position is force, and the Watch will not give it up once taken.

the_long_campaign.name: The Long Campaign
the_long_campaign.description: Not this battle — the war. Every engagement this beat feeds intelligence, every kill team preserves strength, every position taken with an eye to what comes next cycle. Strategic patience is the posture.

lord_executioner._description: The Lord Executioner sets the theatre-level killing doctrine for the beat. His authority shapes how Champions below him prosecute war.

the_headsmans_mark.name: The Headsman's Mark
the_headsmans_mark.description: One target. Every asset, every stratagem, every kill team bent toward the destruction of a single designated threat. The mark is death.

no_quarter_given.name: No Quarter Given
no_quarter_given.description: Total war. The Watch does not slow, does not negotiate, does not pause. Overwhelming force. Overkill is doctrine.

righteous_severance.name: Righteous Severance
righteous_severance.description: The precise kill. Minimum expenditure. Maximum result. The Lord Executioner names a method and the Watch adheres to it — every death efficient, every stratagem justified.

death_by_degrees.name: Death by Degrees
death_by_degrees.description: Attrition before the kill. The Lord Executioner prescribes systematic degradation — degrade across multiple ops, deny the enemy the ability to regenerate, then execute cleanly when nothing remains to resist.

scorched_execution.name: Scorched Execution
scorched_execution.description: Not one target — one capability. The Lord Executioner removes the enemy's means entirely: logistics, command infrastructure, ritual nodes, breeding chambers. The killing is systemic.

champion_killer.name: Champion Killer
champion_killer.description: The Lord Executioner marks the enemy's finest warrior for immediate destruction. Champions draw attention — kill teams are vectored accordingly, and the enemy loses its warrior-elite in a single focused beat.

vanishing_blade.name: Vanishing Blade
vanishing_blade.description: Kill clean. Leave nothing. The Lord Executioner's doctrine: the Watch's presence is felt only in the enemy's absence — stealth, precision, silence. No declaration. Just the dead.

the_binding_sentence.name: The Binding Sentence
the_binding_sentence.description: Warp-touched, daemonically influenced, Chaos-tainted — the Lord Executioner issues formal condemning sentence against a designated abomination. Kill teams carry both Imperial authority and the precise methodology to carry it out.

overkill_mandate.name: Overkill Mandate
overkill_mandate.description: Sufficiency is insufficient. The Lord Executioner prescribes excess — every asset committed to every target, every strat employed, every kill team that can reach an objective does. Nothing confirmed alive.

patience_before_the_strike.name: Patience Before the Strike
patience_before_the_strike.description: The Lord Executioner issues a stay of execution — intel runs first, every kill team confirms before committing. The killing doctrine: know everything, then strike once, with everything. No wasted blade.

tear_the_throat.name: Tear the Throat
tear_the_throat.description: Brutal. Immediate. The Lord Executioner identifies the most exposed point and prescribes direct assault without hesitation. Wherever the enemy is weakest, the killing begins there and does not stop.

the_emperors_sentence.name: The Emperor's Sentence
the_emperors_sentence.description: Holy authority carried in the blade. The Lord Executioner invokes Imperial sanction — every kill this beat is a formal execution, absolute and righteous. The killing doctrine elevates beyond tactic into theology.

surgical_priority.name: Surgical Priority
surgical_priority.description: Minimum expenditure, maximum result. The Lord Executioner names the single kill that changes everything else — one target, precisely identified, precisely removed. The rest of the battlefield resolves by consequence.

watch_captain._description: The Watch Captain translates the Watch Master's theatre order into a company-level directive. Shaped by WM theatre order and Lord Executioner execution style.

prosecute_with_vigour.name: Prosecute with Vigour
prosecute_with_vigour.description: Full commitment. The company drives at the objective without reservation. Every kill team in motion, every specialist pushing forward.

calculated_advance.name: Calculated Advance
calculated_advance.description: Methodical prosecution. The company secures each gain before the next push. Kill teams are protected assets, not expendable tools.

hold_and_endure.name: Hold and Endure
hold_and_endure.description: The company is the wall. Kill teams operate behind it. The Captain anchors the line and does not yield what has been taken.

forward_without_pause.name: Forward Without Pause
forward_without_pause.description: No hesitation, no consolidation between objectives. The company drives through, takes each gain as a staging point for the next push, and denies the enemy any moment to regroup.

command_the_flanks.name: Command the Flanks
command_the_flanks.description: The Captain opens secondary approaches. Kill teams operate on vectors the enemy cannot defend simultaneously — not a frontal assault, but a company-wide pressure that comes from every direction at once.

iron_line.name: Iron Line
iron_line.description: The company holds. The Captain establishes a defensible perimeter and refuses to yield it — every kill team anchored to defined positions, the line maintained regardless of pressure.

coordinated_strike.name: Coordinated Strike
coordinated_strike.description: Every kill team in the company hits simultaneously. The Captain synchronises operations so the enemy cannot respond to one threat without exposing themselves to another — pressure is total, response is impossible.

preserve_combat_power.name: Preserve Combat Power
preserve_combat_power.description: The Captain prioritises the company's longevity over short-term gains. Kill teams take objectives with minimal exposure, avoid attritional engagements, and return stronger than they left. Efficiency is the mandate.

faith_and_steel.name: Faith and Steel
faith_and_steel.description: The Captain declares the company's purpose in the Emperor's name. Tactical objectives become sacred duty — every kill team fights with the combined weight of doctrine and devotion.

punish_overextension.name: Punish Overextension
punish_overextension.description: The Captain watches for the enemy to commit too far and hits them in the moment of their extension. Every kill team ready to respond when the enemy shows their flank — reactive aggression at company scale.

the_company_endures.name: The Company Endures
the_company_endures.description: Whatever this beat costs, the company will be stronger at the end of it. Recovery, sustainability, maintaining the force — the Captain's mandate is not the kill, but the company's operational continuity.

machine_supported_advance.name: Machine-Supported Advance
machine_supported_advance.description: The Captain incorporates the company's technological assets as the advance's backbone. Techmarine support, auspex coverage, pre-cleared kill zones — the company advances behind an intelligence and mechanical superiority the enemy cannot match.

silent_dominion.name: Silent Dominion
silent_dominion.description: The company operates without announcement. Objectives taken, threats neutralised, positions secured — all without the enemy knowing who is responsible or where the Watch will strike next.

watch_lieutenant._description: The Watch Lieutenant identifies and drives secondary vectors — exploits what the Captain's order opens, fills what it cannot reach. Shaped by Captain company order and Company Champion execution.

press_the_flanks.name: Press the Flanks
press_the_flanks.description: Secondary vectors. The Lieutenant identifies the edges the enemy cannot cover and sends the kill teams through. The flanks belong to the Watch.

fire_and_advance.name: Fire and Advance
fire_and_advance.description: Classic Watch doctrine. Suppression and movement. Pressure maintained through every phase, no enemy position allowed to solidify.

consolidate_gains.name: Consolidate Gains
consolidate_gains.description: Lock what has been won. The Lieutenant ensures nothing slips back — positions hardened, kill teams resupplied, lines drawn before the next push.

find_the_seam.name: Find the Seam
find_the_seam.description: The Lieutenant hunts the gap between the enemy's defensive sectors — the point where two units' responsibilities meet and neither owns. Kill teams are pushed through it before it closes.

maximum_pressure.name: Maximum Pressure
maximum_pressure.description: The Lieutenant pushes every kill team to their operational limit simultaneously. No rotation, no reserve — maximum output for the entire ops window. The enemy runs dry before the Watch does.

anchor_and_exploit.name: Anchor and Exploit
anchor_and_exploit.description: One kill team holds the enemy's attention; the others exploit what that engagement opens. The Lieutenant uses the Captain's line as a lever — holding and striking simultaneously from positions the enemy cannot address at once.

hardened_advance.name: Hardened Advance
hardened_advance.description: The Lieutenant's kill teams advance with armour rites fresh and positions covered. Every gain is secured before the next movement. Slow, methodical, and absolutely impossible to roll back.

lightning_exploitation.name: Lightning Exploitation
lightning_exploitation.description: When the Captain's assault creates a breach, the Lieutenant drives kill teams through it before the enemy can seal it. Speed is everything — the exploitation is faster than the enemy's reaction time.

watch_the_voids.name: Watch the Voids
watch_the_voids.description: The Lieutenant assigns kill teams to the sectors the Captain's main directive does not fully cover. Every gap is closed, every approach denied, every blind spot covered. The Captain attacks; the Lieutenant ensures nothing attacks back.

bleed_them_white.name: Bleed Them White
bleed_them_white.description: The Lieutenant directs a sustained attrition campaign on the enemy's secondary elements. Not the decisive kill — the slow drain. Every op this beat degrades the enemy's reinforcement pool and its ability to sustain the fight.

the_killing_tempo.name: The Killing Tempo
the_killing_tempo.description: The Lieutenant sets an operational rhythm the enemy cannot match. Kill teams cycle in and out at a pace that denies the enemy any window to respond, reorganise, or recover. Tempo is the weapon.

the_dark_work.name: The Dark Work
the_dark_work.description: Secondary objectives that the official record does not acknowledge. The Lieutenant ensures certain targets are addressed quietly — evidence secured, witnesses removed, assets recovered — without the Captain's broader mandate needing to account for them.

sacred_deployment.name: Sacred Deployment
sacred_deployment.description: The Lieutenant places kill teams with chaplaincy blessing before commitment — each team consecrated for the specific threat they face. Faith becomes tactical doctrine: the right brothers, prepared in the right way, for the right enemy.

company_champion._description: The Company Champion sets the company-level killing doctrine. Shaped by Watch Captain order and Lord Executioner execution above.

honour_the_duel.name: Honour the Duel
honour_the_duel.description: Challenge the enemy's finest. The Champion seeks the hardest blade and breaks it — drawing the enemy's strength onto a single point, shattering their morale with it.

break_the_shield.name: Break the Shield
break_the_shield.description: Kill the anchors. Target cohesion, not numbers — destroy the units holding the line and the rest scatter. Formation is the enemy's weapon; remove it.

blade_consecrated.name: Blade Consecrated
blade_consecrated.description: Every kill is a rite. The Champion sets a ritualized killing doctrine — deliberate, certain, each death a statement of the Watch's authority over this battlefield.

the_open_challenge.name: The Open Challenge
the_open_challenge.description: The Champion steps forward — the enemy's finest is identified and challenged before the kill teams engage. Draw out the apex threat, force the enemy to commit their strongest, then remove it. The rest is cleanup.

shatter_the_spine.name: Shatter the Spine
shatter_the_spine.description: The Champion targets the command structure directly. Not the warriors — the officers, the leaders, the communications nodes. Remove what coordinates the enemy and the body falls apart.

the_rite_of_killing.name: The Rite of Killing
the_rite_of_killing.description: Every death is a rite performed correctly. The Champion prescribes a killing doctrine built on precision and ceremony — each kill made in the manner that honours the Chapter's traditions and demonstrates the Watch's authority over this battlefield.

force_the_error.name: Force the Error
force_the_error.description: Patience. The Champion applies calculated pressure until the enemy makes a mistake — overcommits, exposes a flank, breaks formation. When the error comes, the killing stroke is already in motion.

the_red_work.name: The Red Work
the_red_work.description: No elegance, no doctrine, no pretension. The Champion sets a killing mandate of pure, sustained violence — maximise enemy dead, minimise Watch casualties, by any means required. The field is cleared.

witness_and_record.name: Witness and Record
witness_and_record.description: The Champion ensures every kill made by this company is acknowledged, documented, and reported. Excellence is not merely achieved — it is proven. The company's kills become the campaign record.

void_touched_quarry.name: Void-Touched Quarry
void_touched_quarry.description: The Champion designates a warp-corrupted or daemon-possessed target as the company's primary kill. Fighting the warp requires different methodology — the Champion provides the execution doctrine for what cannot be killed by ordinary means.

blademaster_doctrine.name: Blademaster Doctrine
blademaster_doctrine.description: The Champion introduces a formal melee-excellence mandate for the company. Kill teams are evaluated on close-quarters performance — those who meet the Champion's standard receive his personal commendation and the doctrine intensifies around their example.

cut_the_sinew.name: Cut the Sinew
cut_the_sinew.description: The Champion targets the connections that make the enemy dangerous — the bonds between units, the supply links, the communication threads. Remove the sinew and the musculature of the enemy force tears itself apart.

unbreakable_execution.name: Unbreakable Execution
unbreakable_execution.description: The Champion holds the company's killing doctrine immovable in the face of whatever the enemy brings. Casualties do not alter the mandate. Setbacks do not change the method. The company kills the same way, regardless of cost.

watch_sergeant._description: The Watch Sergeant locks the kill team's fighting doctrine for the ops window. Shapes the personal focus options available to battle-line below. Shaped by the full command chain above.

oath_of_moment.name: Oath of Moment
oath_of_moment.description: One objective. One purpose. One kill team. Everything stripped to a single lethal focus — the oath is sworn and the kill team does not turn from it until it is kept or broken.

combined_arms.name: Combined Arms
combined_arms.description: Trust the kill team. Every specialist's contribution matters, every angle covered, interlocking fields of expertise working as one. The kill team is the weapon.

duty_unto_death.name: Duty Unto Death
duty_unto_death.description: No extraction. No retreat. The mission ends with completion or it ends with the kill team's last round. The Sergeant does not plan for failure.

the_killing_oath.name: The Killing Oath
the_killing_oath.description: The Sergeant names a target and binds the kill team to its destruction by personal oath. Not a tactical objective — a sworn promise made before the team commits. The kill team does not return until the oath is fulfilled.

ghost_advance.name: Ghost Advance
ghost_advance.description: The Sergeant leads the kill team through without contact until the optimal moment — patience, concealment, and absolute noise discipline until the killing ground is set. The enemy never sees them coming.

line_unbroken.name: Line Unbroken
line_unbroken.description: The Sergeant establishes a holding position and refuses to yield it. The kill team does not advance and does not fall back — they hold, they endure, they make the enemy pay for every attempt to move them.

coordinated_volley.name: Coordinated Volley
coordinated_volley.description: Every weapon fires together — the Sergeant coordinates timing so the kill team's fire output is a single combined event rather than individual shots. No target survives a focused volley from a Deathwatch kill team acting as one.

brothers_covered.name: Brothers Covered
brothers_covered.description: No one goes unsupported. The Sergeant ensures every movement has cover, every advance is screened, every brother who is out in the open has eyes and weapons on the angles that could threaten them. The kill team fights as one organism.

contact_imminent.name: Contact Imminent
contact_imminent.description: The Sergeant reads the intelligence picture and prepares the kill team for an engagement that is already in motion. No approach phase — straight to the confrontation, from the first moment of deployment. Reaction speed and aggression are the doctrine.

by_the_numbers.name: By the Numbers
by_the_numbers.description: The Sergeant executes the assigned doctrine with textbook precision. No improvisation, no deviation from the plan — every battle-drill executed correctly, every contingency covered. The kill team performs exactly as trained.

the_target_marked.name: The Target Marked
the_target_marked.description: The Sergeant designates the kill team's primary target before deployment and builds the entire engagement plan around its elimination. Everything else is secondary. The target is the operation.

void_trained.name: Void-Trained
void_trained.description: The Sergeant adapts the kill team's doctrine to the specific characteristics of a warp-touched or daemonically influenced environment. Standard engagement protocols modified for what can only be killed by specific means — the kill team is prepared for what standard doctrine cannot address.

make_every_shot_count.name: Make Every Shot Count
make_every_shot_count.description: The Sergeant enforces a doctrine of absolute precision — no ammunition expended without a confirmed target, no kill without maximum effectiveness. The kill team achieves its objectives with fewer shots and more kills.

forgemaster._description: The Forgemaster sets machine-doctrine at theatre level — an order that flows down to every Watch Techmarine in the companies below. His pick determines what the machine track prioritises across every op this beat.

omnissianic_mandate.name: Omnissianic Mandate
omnissianic_mandate.description: The Forgemaster declares the Omnissiah's will for the entire theatre — every weapon on every kill team sacred, every system attended, every machine spirit aligned before the ops window opens. The machine doctrine of the Watch is set.

hostile_acquisition.name: Hostile Acquisition
hostile_acquisition.description: Strategic directive: the enemy's technology comes home. Every op this beat, recovery of xeno-tech, Heretek devices, and Chaos engines is a standing order. The Forgemaster will learn what hunts the Watch.

iron_resupply.name: Iron Resupply
iron_resupply.description: The Forgemaster controls the theatre's logistical spine. Ammunition, field repairs, system redundancy — no company runs dry, no kill team goes in degraded. The Watch sustains itself.

weapon_litany_invoked.name: Weapon Litany Invoked
weapon_litany_invoked.description: The Forgemaster consecrates the armament of every kill team in the theatre. Weapon spirits stirred, machine souls aligned — this beat, the Watch's weapons are blessed before they fire. More than maintenance; this is preparation as doctrine.

forge_the_breach.name: Forge the Breach
forge_the_breach.description: Technical doctrine of assault. The Forgemaster prepares equipment specifically for breaking fortified positions — melta charges, breaching frames, void-seal cutters. Walls do not stop the Watch.

relic_reclamation_protocol.name: Relic Reclamation Protocol
relic_reclamation_protocol.description: The Forgemaster activates theatre-wide relic-detection doctrine. Every op this beat prioritises recovery of Adeptus Mechanicus artefacts, lost STCs, corrupted machine spirits, and Watch Station legacies.

null_the_machines.name: Null the Machines
null_the_machines.description: Enemy technological capabilities targeted. Void shields mapped and jammed, Daemon engines identified for priority kill, automata command links disrupted. The Forgemaster turns machine-war doctrine against the enemy's own systems.

adaptive_logistics.name: Adaptive Logistics
adaptive_logistics.description: The Forgemaster restructures the theatre's supply architecture on the fly. Kill teams in the field receive technical support tailored to the specific threat encountered — the machine doctrine bends to serve the mission.

the_iron_covenant.name: The Iron Covenant
the_iron_covenant.description: The Forgemaster declares a covenant with the machine spirits of the entire theatre: weapons will not fail, armour will not break, vehicles will not die until the mission is complete. He backs it with ritual and labour alike.

field_auspex_augmentation.name: Field Auspex Augmentation
field_auspex_augmentation.description: Theatre-wide auspex enhancement. The Forgemaster upgrades every kill team's scanning and detection capability — nothing hides, no signature is too faint, no threat goes unlocated before kill teams close.

armour_rites_supreme.name: Armour Rites Supreme
armour_rites_supreme.description: Total focus on protection. The Forgemaster prescribes augmented armour rites across the theatre — ceramite blessed, ablative layers reinforced, auto-sanguine systems primed. Kill teams take hits that would shatter lesser warriors.

corrosive_countermeasures.name: Corrosive Countermeasures
corrosive_countermeasures.description: The Forgemaster prepares counter-tech specifically for the identified enemy: xenos bio-technology, Heretek corruption, warp-machine hybrids. Kill teams carry specialised weapons and protocols the enemy cannot anticipate.

zero_failure_tolerance.name: Zero Failure Tolerance
zero_failure_tolerance.description: The Forgemaster implements a theatre-wide equipment audit under war conditions. No degraded weapon, no compromised system goes to the field. The cost is time and labour; the benefit is that nothing breaks at the critical moment.

watch_techmarine._description: The Watch Techmarine executes the Forgemaster's theatre directive at company level — his pick is how this company applies the machine doctrine handed down. Shaped by Forgemaster's sacred_directive above.

machine_rite.name: Machine Rite
machine_rite.description: Company weapons consecrated, servo-arms aligned, machine spirits of this company willing and ready. The Techmarine sees to every piece of kit before the kill teams move.

field_strip_and_repair.name: Field Strip and Repair
field_strip_and_repair.description: No kit goes into the field degraded. The Techmarine tears down, rebuilds, and certifies every weapon and system this company carries. Failures cost lives; the Techmarine ensures there are none.

scavenge_and_salvage.name: Scavenge and Salvage
scavenge_and_salvage.description: This company's Techmarine works the battlefield — enemy materiel claimed, broken Watch equipment rebuilt, nothing wasted. The company leaves richer than it arrived.

machine_spirit_alignment.name: Machine Spirit Alignment
machine_spirit_alignment.description: The Techmarine binds the kill teams' wargear to the specific character of this world's machine spirits. Weapons that understand where they are perform better — the Techmarine ensures every piece of equipment is attuned.

field_fabrication.name: Field Fabrication
field_fabrication.description: The Techmarine works without the Manufactorum. Salvage, captured materials, and improvised forging extend the company's operational endurance beyond what the supply chain can sustain. Necessity breeds innovation.

auspex_saturation.name: Auspex Saturation
auspex_saturation.description: Every kill team carries Techmarine-calibrated auspex units. The Techmarine processes the data feeds in real-time and routes targeting intelligence to where it can be actioned. Blind spots become kill zones.

denial_rites.name: Denial Rites
denial_rites.description: The Techmarine applies active countermeasures against enemy technology. Disruption patterns, anti-signal rites, precision jamming — the enemy's war machines and communications are denied to them. What the machine gives, the Techmarine can take away.

armour_rites_intensive.name: Armour Rites Intensive
armour_rites_intensive.description: The Techmarine sacrifices offensive output to maintain every suit of power armour at its operational peak. Ceramite integrity, void shield ratings, system redundancies — the company's armour becomes its primary weapon this beat.

scavenge_and_adapt.name: Scavenge and Adapt
scavenge_and_adapt.description: The Techmarine catalogues enemy technology and recovers whatever can be reconditioned. Not simply trophies — functional enhancements, counter-measures, and analytical data that give the company an edge in the next engagement.

warp_shielding_protocols.name: Warp-Shielding Protocols
warp_shielding_protocols.description: The Techmarine implements machine-based defences against psychic and warp interference. Not the Librarian's path — iron and circuitry, null-field generators, mechanically enforced barriers. The machine pushes the warp back.

blessed_ammunition_rites.name: Blessed Ammunition Rites
blessed_ammunition_rites.description: Every bolt, every shell, every plasma charge is consecrated at the Techmarine's forge station. The blessing is technical as much as spiritual — quality control, sacred geometry, optimal charge state. These rounds do not miss their purpose.

infrastructure_seizure.name: Infrastructure Seizure
infrastructure_seizure.description: The Techmarine leads the operation to capture and activate enemy technology in place. Power plants, vox networks, defensive systems — turned over to the Watch's use before the enemy can deny them. Technology becomes a strategic trophy.

the_living_fortress.name: The Living Fortress
the_living_fortress.description: Every position the company holds becomes a fortified strongpoint under the Techmarine's direction. Defensive constructions, automated sentinels, layered sensors — each Watch position becomes harder to assault than it was to take.

chief_apothecary._description: The Chief Apothecary issues a theatre-wide medical decree for the beat — an order that flows down to every Watch Apothecary in the companies. His pick determines what the medical track prioritises across every op.

gene_seed_imperative.name: Gene-Seed Imperative
gene_seed_imperative.description: Theatre-wide declaration: no progenoid falls on any field this beat. The Chief Apothecary's authority is absolute — recovery before retreat, always. The Chapter's future does not end here.

battlefield_augmentation.name: Battlefield Augmentation
battlefield_augmentation.description: HC-level stimm protocols authorised. The Watch's physiological limits are extended theatre-wide — the cost is accepted. The kill teams fight harder, longer, past the point flesh alone would break.

quarantine_authority.name: Quarantine Authority
quarantine_authority.description: The Chief Apothecary declares a biological or warp-biological threat across the theatre. All companies operate under quarantine protocols — identify, isolate, excise before it spreads to the Watch itself.

apothecarion_field_forward.name: Apothecarion Field Forward
apothecarion_field_forward.description: The Chief Apothecary moves theatre medical capability to the front. Apothecaries operate in the kill team's operational zone — gene-seed recovered in the field, not after the fact.

iron_constitution.name: Iron Constitution
iron_constitution.description: Theatre-wide physiological hardening protocol. Stress-inoculation, environmental resistance, fatigue countermeasures — kill teams are prepared for prolonged operations in conditions that would break baseline forces.

the_chapter_endures.name: The Chapter Endures
the_chapter_endures.description: The Chief Apothecary declares the Chapter's continuation the absolute priority. Every progenoid recovered, every fallen brother witnessed, regardless of cost to tactical outcomes. The Chapter is the mission.

black_carapace_interrogation.name: Black Carapace Interrogation
black_carapace_interrogation.description: The Chief Apothecary extracts intelligence from the fallen — enemy and Watch alike. Neurological traces, pheromone identification, combat bio-signature analysis. What the dead experienced informs what the living must do.

combat_augmentation_protocol.name: Combat Augmentation Protocol
combat_augmentation_protocol.description: Full pre-battle physiological optimisation. Stimm cocktails, organ-priming, threshold-expansion — the Chief Apothecary signs off on a biological doctrine that pushes kill teams beyond their limits before the first shot.

toxin_countermeasure.name: Toxin Countermeasure
toxin_countermeasure.description: The Chief Apothecary prepares specific counter-biological protocols for the identified threat vector. Tyranid bio-toxins, Chaos corruption, xeno-spore environments — kill teams operate clean where others would be incapacitated.

witness_every_fall.name: Witness Every Fall
witness_every_fall.description: The Chief Apothecary mandates that no battle-brother falls without confirmation, harvest, and witness. This beat, every op carries formal Apothecarion oversight. The dead are not abandoned — they are received.

sustained_operations_doctrine.name: Sustained Operations Doctrine
sustained_operations_doctrine.description: The Chief Apothecary extends the operational window. Fatigue compressed, damage managed in the field, stimms controlled for sustained output. Kill teams operate for longer than the enemy can plan for.

psychofortification_rites.name: Psychofortification Rites
psychofortification_rites.description: The Chief Apothecary reinforces mental and neurological resilience across the theatre. Against psychic intrusion, warp-madness, and terror-weapon effects — the mind-resilience of the force is hardened by Apothecarion decree.

accelerated_recovery.name: Accelerated Recovery
accelerated_recovery.description: Reduced downtime between ops. The Chief Apothecary implements fast-return medical protocols — wounds stabilised and cleared in minimum time. Kill teams return to operational status faster than the enemy's reinforcement cycle.

watch_apothecary._description: The Watch Apothecary applies the Chief Apothecary's theatre decree at company level — how this company's medical support operates this beat. Shaped by Chief Apothecary medical_authority above.

progenoid_priority.name: Progenoid Priority
progenoid_priority.description: No brother in this company falls without witness. Gene-seed is recovered. This company's legacy persists regardless of what the battlefield costs.

combat_stimms.name: Combat Stimms
combat_stimms.description: Push this company's kill teams beyond their limits. The Apothecary administers, the brothers endure. The price is paid later.

purge_the_corruption.name: Purge the Corruption
purge_the_corruption.description: Taint identified in this company's operational zone — Chaos corruption, xenos bio-weapons, warp sickness. The Apothecary cuts it out before it spreads. This company stays clean.

combat_extraction.name: Combat Extraction
combat_extraction.description: The Apothecary builds extraction protocols into every kill team's engagement plan. No brother is abandoned — planned withdrawal routes, prioritised targets, coordinated collapse into defended positions. The Apothecary does not wait to be called.

gene_seed_integrity.name: Gene-Seed Integrity
gene_seed_integrity.description: The Apothecary prioritises the biological continuity of the Watch above tactical considerations. Progenoids are secured, gene-seed recovered, the biological chain of the Adeptus Astartes maintained even at cost to the mission. Some things matter more than the operation.

stimm_doctrine.name: Stimm Doctrine
stimm_doctrine.description: The Apothecary administers combat stimulants with calculated precision before operations begin. Enhanced reaction time, pain suppression, physical output at the edge of tolerance — the kill teams perform at maximum capacity for a defined window.

the_living_defiance.name: The Living Defiance
the_living_defiance.description: Brothers who would otherwise fall are kept in the fight. The Apothecary moves through the engagement, maintaining wounded brothers at combat effectiveness, refusing to allow the enemy the satisfaction of the kill. The Watch fights until it chooses not to.

toxin_analysis.name: Toxin Analysis
toxin_analysis.description: The Apothecary catalogues xenos biological weapons encountered this beat — toxins, pathogens, biological agents — and develops countermeasures in the field. Current threat neutralised; future threats anticipated. The company does not die to the same poison twice.

field_surgery_bay.name: Field Surgery Bay
field_surgery_bay.description: The Apothecary establishes a forward surgical position within the operational area. Brothers cycle through between engagements — wounds treated, armour patched, combat effectiveness restored before the next op begins. The company's attrition rate drops dramatically.

the_martyred_record.name: The Martyred Record
the_martyred_record.description: Every brother who falls this beat is acknowledged by name, their manner of death recorded, their gene-seed secured or their sacrifice documented. The Apothecary carries the company's losses as a sacred obligation — none fall without witness.

pre_deployment_assessment.name: Pre-Deployment Assessment
pre_deployment_assessment.description: The Apothecary evaluates every brother before they are committed. Combat-effective, reserve, or medically withdrawn — the Apothecary makes the call and the company deploys only those who are ready. Better to fight with fewer brothers at full capability.

the_red_tithe.name: The Red Tithe
the_red_tithe.description: The Apothecary accounts for the blood spent this beat against the blood available. Calculated expenditure — no brother is committed without analysis, no casualty without tactical value. The Apothecary holds the company's biological budget.

warp_exposure_triage.name: Warp Exposure Triage
warp_exposure_triage.description: The Apothecary performs psychic contamination assessments and administers counteracting treatments. Brothers exposed to warp influence are evaluated, quarantined if necessary, treated with the full spectrum of the Apothecary's art. The warp does not claim them if the Apothecary can prevent it.

high_chaplain._description: The High Chaplain issues theatre-wide spiritual doctrine for the beat — an order that flows down to every Watch Chaplain in the companies and shapes the Judiciar's sentence options at KT tier. His word is the Watch's faith made law.

the_eternal_vigil.name: The Eternal Vigil
the_eternal_vigil.description: The High Chaplain speaks for the dead. Theatre-wide declaration — every brother who has fallen on the Reach is witnessed. Every brother still fighting knows it. The Vigil is why they endure and why they cannot stop.

crusade_sanction.name: Crusade Sanction
crusade_sanction.description: Holy war declared at theatre level. The High Chaplain consecrates the Watch's purpose this beat — every kill team acts with the Emperor's direct sanction, every death a righteous act, every advance a sacred charge.

rites_of_absolution.name: Rites of Absolution
rites_of_absolution.description: The Watch is cleansed before it fights. Spiritual doubt, Chaos taint, warp-corruption, oaths broken under duress — the High Chaplain burns it away with rite and declaration before the ops window opens.

the_litany_of_hate.name: The Litany of Hate
the_litany_of_hate.description: The High Chaplain delivers theatre-wide war-litanies that strip fear and hesitation from every brother in the Watch. This beat, kill teams fight without restraint — the enemy is granted no mercy and no quarter.

oath_of_iron.name: Oath of Iron
oath_of_iron.description: Every active brother in the theatre swears an iron oath before the ops window opens — an oath of endurance, not achievement. Whatever the battlefield demands, the Watch will still be standing at the end.

the_speaking_of_names.name: The Speaking of Names
the_speaking_of_names.description: The High Chaplain names the fallen of the Reach — dead Watch brothers whose sacrifice consecrates this theatre. The living fight knowing those names stand behind them. Every advance is for the dead.

condemn_the_heretic.name: Condemn the Heretic
condemn_the_heretic.description: Formal theological condemnation issued against an identified traitor, xenos collaborator, or Chaos affiliate on the committed node. The High Chaplain's word is now the Watch's mandate. No mercy, no negotiation.

the_fire_unquenched.name: The Fire Unquenched
the_fire_unquenched.description: Theatre-wide spiritual fortification against despair. The High Chaplain addresses the force directly — whatever has happened, whatever will happen, the Watch does not break. The fire does not go out.

purgation_rites.name: Purgation Rites
purgation_rites.description: Theatre-wide spiritual cleansing declared before the ops window. Chaplains attend every kill team at formation — doubts, Chaos taints, warp-corruptions, broken oaths are purged. The Watch goes in clean.

sanctioned_fury.name: Sanctioned Fury
sanctioned_fury.description: The High Chaplain releases the Watch from its restraint. Controlled aggression is dispensed with — sanctioned rage is the doctrine. The enemy will know what it means to face warriors who fight with spiritual fire and no leash.

vigil_unyielding.name: Vigil Unyielding
vigil_unyielding.description: The High Chaplain's declaration for the beat: not one position, not one gain, not one brother will be surrendered. Spiritual tenacity is the doctrine — the Watch holds everything it has. Nothing yields.

litany_of_revelation.name: Litany of Revelation
litany_of_revelation.description: The High Chaplain speaks to the hidden enemy. Spiritual doctrine of exposure — what conceals itself, what lies, what operates in shadow is condemned and revealed. The Watch sees what hides.

bond_of_brotherhood.name: Bond of Brotherhood
bond_of_brotherhood.description: The High Chaplain orders every kill team in the theatre to formally witness each other's oaths before the ops window. Brotherhood is combat doctrine — no brother fights alone, and no achievement goes unshared.

watch_chaplain._description: The Watch Chaplain translates the High Chaplain's spiritual decree into a company-level litany — the specific faith weapon he wields for this company this beat. Shaped by High Chaplain spiritual_decree above. Judiciar's sentence is also influenced by this pick.

the_unbroken_oath.name: The Unbroken Oath
the_unbroken_oath.description: The oath holds for this company. Endurance, resolve, duty that does not flinch before the impossible — the Chaplain reminds every brother what they swore and why it still stands.

litany_of_wrath.name: Litany of Wrath
litany_of_wrath.description: Holy fury consecrated in war-psalms. The Chaplain's words are weapons — battle-litanies drive this company past fear, past pain, into something that does not stop until the enemy is gone.

rites_of_witness.name: Rites of Witness
rites_of_witness.description: Every deed witnessed, every death recorded, every brotherhood in this company confirmed. The Chaplain is the company's memory — the Vigil made personal.

the_rite_of_battle.name: The Rite of Battle
the_rite_of_battle.description: The Chaplain performs the formal battle-rites before every kill team commits. Purpose clarified, oaths renewed, hatred consecrated. The kill teams leave the briefing knowing exactly what is required of them and exactly why it matters.

the_litany_of_hatred.name: The Litany of Hatred
the_litany_of_hatred.description: The Chaplain names the enemy with precision — their nature, their heresy, their threat to the Imperium. The kill teams do not fight abstractions; they fight specific, named evil. Hatred made concrete becomes the most reliable weapon.

the_burden_carried.name: The Burden Carried
the_burden_carried.description: The Chaplain tends to those who struggle beneath the weight of what they have seen and done. Warp exposure, terrible kills, the accumulation of the campaign's costs — the Chaplain ensures the brothers remain themselves through it all.

oath_renewed.name: Oath Renewed
oath_renewed.description: In a formal ceremony before the company, the Chaplain leads the renewal of battle-oaths. Brothers whose commitments have grown stale or wavered under attrition find purpose re-instilled. The oath is the chain that holds — the Chaplain ensures it holds fast.

suffer_not_the_heretic.name: Suffer Not the Heretic
suffer_not_the_heretic.description: The Chaplain provides formal doctrinal clarity on exactly what must be destroyed without mercy or negotiation. No ambiguity about where mercy ends and duty begins — the Chaplain draws the line in fire and the kill teams know exactly which side everything falls on.

the_martyr_doctrine.name: The Martyr Doctrine
the_martyr_doctrine.description: The Chaplain consecrates the cost — every brother who falls does so in full knowledge of what their sacrifice advances. Purpose transforms death. The kill teams fight harder because they know the Chaplain has already consecrated the worst outcome.

the_darkness_named.name: The Darkness Named
the_darkness_named.description: The Chaplain delivers a formal accounting of the warp's specific expression on this world — its source, its nature, the name of what has invited it. Knowledge of the enemy's spiritual architecture is the first step in its dismantling.

sanctify_the_fallen.name: Sanctify the Fallen
sanctify_the_fallen.description: The Chaplain moves through the aftermath and performs rites over those lost this beat. The fallen are not forgotten — they are formally received into the company's memory. The living fight harder when they know the dead will be honoured.

the_wrath_channelled.name: The Wrath Channelled
the_wrath_channelled.description: The Chaplain converts grief and rage into precision. The company has suffered — the Chaplain ensures that suffering becomes directed violence rather than disorganised fury. Anger made doctrine is the most effective anger.

the_covenant_held.name: The Covenant Held
the_covenant_held.description: The Chaplain draws explicit line of continuity from the founding oaths of the Deathwatch to the current operation. Every kill team is part of something centuries old and worth every cost demanded. The covenant holds — it has always held.

huntmaster._description: The Huntmaster's killing priority for the beat — how the hunt is structured. HC-only; no Company-tier equivalent. The Huntmaster FLAG + any Champion or domain Specialist ENGAGEMENT CALL = prestige terminus kill.

mark_the_apex.name: Mark the Apex
mark_the_apex.description: One prey. The Huntmaster designates the single greatest threat on the field and every kill team is vectored around it. The apex dies first. Everything else follows.

hunt_in_packs.name: Hunt in Packs
hunt_in_packs.description: Multiple vectors, simultaneous pressure. Several kills pursued in parallel — the Reach is hit from every angle at once. No single kill team carries the entire hunt.

bleed_the_beast.name: Bleed the Beast
bleed_the_beast.description: Attrition before the kill. Degrade the prey across multiple operations, deny it strength, erode its support — then take it cleanly when it has nothing left to fight back with.

corner_the_prey.name: Corner the Prey
corner_the_prey.description: Multiple kill teams converge from every available approach, denying the prey any route of withdrawal. The Huntmaster doesn't chase — he closes every exit and waits for the inevitable.

read_the_spoor.name: Read the Spoor
read_the_spoor.description: Intelligence phase runs before the hunt begins. The Huntmaster maps the prey's movement patterns, feeding routes, and lair locations — kill teams deploy knowing exactly where the kill will happen.

running_the_beast_to_ground.name: Running the Beast to Ground
running_the_beast_to_ground.description: Relentless pursuit doctrine. The Huntmaster will not let the prey rest, resupply, or regenerate. Kill teams rotate, maintain constant pressure, and drive the terminus quarry past the point of recovery.

the_killing_ground.name: The Killing Ground
the_killing_ground.description: The Huntmaster prepares the terrain before the prey arrives. Kill zones established, approach vectors seeded with covered positions — the terminus target walks into a battlefield already set for its death.

feast_on_the_worthy.name: Feast on the Worthy
feast_on_the_worthy.description: The Huntmaster opens the hunt to all kill teams. No single designated quarry — whatever terminus-class threat presents, it dies. The watch-list is the whole battlefield.

deny_the_warlord.name: Deny the Warlord
deny_the_warlord.description: The Huntmaster's priority: command decapitation. Remove the entity that commands, coordinates, or empowers the enemy force. The kill is not the terminus creature — it is the leadership that makes the enemy coherent.

void_hunt.name: Void Hunt
void_hunt.description: The prey is not physical. The Huntmaster turns his doctrine toward warp-entities, psyker-constructs, and void-beasts that register on the terminus threat scale. Hunting doctrine adapted for prey that bleeds warp-fire.

the_long_hunt.name: The Long Hunt
the_long_hunt.description: The Huntmaster extends the hunt beyond this beat. Terminus prey marked this cycle, intelligence gathered, approach angles confirmed — even if it escapes now, the next beat the Watch knows exactly where it will be.

sanctified_kill.name: Sanctified Kill
sanctified_kill.description: The Huntmaster declares the terminus prey a spiritual abomination and consecrates the kill in advance. Kill teams carry both tactical doctrine and chaplaincy authority. The target is hunted for the Watch's soul as much as its mission.

maximum_yield.name: Maximum Yield
maximum_yield.description: Every kill team capable of engaging a terminus target this beat is cleared to do so. The Huntmaster abandons exclusivity — this is not a precision hunt. It is a coordinated annihilation.

void_warden._description: The Void Warden sets psychic doctrine at theatre level — an order that flows down to every Watch Librarian in the companies. As Chief Librarian, his decree determines how the warp track engages across every op this beat.

warp_interdiction.name: Warp Interdiction
warp_interdiction.description: The Chief Librarian raises an iron screen across the entire theatre — enemy psykers find no purchase, no summoning goes uncontested, no warp-entity crosses without the Watch's knowledge. The warp is denied.

prescient_command.name: Prescient Command
prescient_command.description: Foresight at theatre scale. The Watch Master's decisions are informed by psychic intelligence that the enemy cannot have anticipated. The Void Warden sees the battle several moves ahead and positions the Watch accordingly.

void_condemnation.name: Void Condemnation
void_condemnation.description: The Chief Librarian identifies a warp-entity or psyker of significance and condemns it at theatre level — warp signature mapped, approach vectors known. The Watch goes in with the target already marked for destruction.

silence_the_choir.name: Silence the Choir
silence_the_choir.description: Enemy psyker networks identified and targeted for suppression. The Void Warden coordinates theatre-wide psychic denial operations — no enemy choir sings in concert this beat, every summoning disrupted before it manifests.

warp_cartography.name: Warp Cartography
warp_cartography.description: The Void Warden maps the warp-topology of the committed node. Rift locations, psychic resonance points, intrusion vectors — kill teams move with full awareness of where the immaterium bleeds into real-space.

the_emperors_shield.name: The Emperor's Shield
the_emperors_shield.description: The Void Warden raises a psychic fortress across the theatre. Daemons find no purchase, summoning rituals collapse before completion, the warp's influence on this operation is reduced to near-nothing. Absolute psychic defence.

forge_a_weapon.name: Forge a Weapon
forge_a_weapon.description: The Void Warden identifies a psyker of value among the Watch and focuses theatre-level resources on one combined strike through the warp. The enemy's psychic strength becomes the kill team's targeting solution.

deep_warp_surveillance.name: Deep Warp Surveillance
deep_warp_surveillance.description: The Void Warden extends psychic intelligence assets into the deep warp. Enemy reinforcement vectors, daemon-world coordinates, immaterial staging points — the Watch knows what is coming before it arrives in real-space.

the_veil_holds.name: The Veil Holds
the_veil_holds.description: The Void Warden commits every psychic asset to maintaining the integrity of real-space on the committed node. No rift, no summoning, no warp-intrusion succeeds while the Chief Librarian stands the watch.

psychic_decapitation.name: Psychic Decapitation
psychic_decapitation.description: One psychic threat of command-class magnitude identified and targeted for elimination. The Void Warden directs all theatre psychic assets toward a single entity — remove the mind that directs the enemy's warp capability.

resonance_reading.name: Resonance Reading
resonance_reading.description: The Void Warden reads the psychic resonance of the committed node's recent history. Atrocities, rites, mass deaths — all leave warp-signatures the Chief Librarian translates into tactical intelligence for the kill teams.

warp_weaponisation.name: Warp Weaponisation
warp_weaponisation.description: The Void Warden turns the enemy's own warp signature against it. Psychic doctrine of aggression — every rift, every daemonic presence, every warp-taint on the node is identified and weaponised by the Watch's Librarians.

null_the_prophet.name: Null the Prophet
null_the_prophet.description: Enemy morale relies on their warp-seer, daemon-speaker, or prophet-demagogue. The Void Warden designates that individual for psychic nullification — silence the voice, and the enemy's certainty collapses with it.

watch_librarian._description: The Watch Librarian applies the Void Warden's psychic decree at company level — how this company's psyker engages the warp this beat. Shaped by Void Warden psychic_decree above.

null_veil.name: Null Veil
null_veil.description: Suppress the warp around this company. The Librarian raises an iron screen — the enemy's psychic advantages are denied, nothing crosses uninvited into this company's operational space.

the_long_dark.name: The Long Dark
the_long_dark.description: Psychic mapping and foresight at company scale. The Librarian reads what the warp holds before the kill teams move — positions them around what they cannot yet see.

pierce_the_veil.name: Pierce the Veil
pierce_the_veil.description: Offensive psychic application for this company. The Librarian strikes through the warp before the enemy can weaponise it — the warp is not the enemy's domain here, it is the Watch's.

the_sight_maintained.name: The Sight Maintained
the_sight_maintained.description: The Librarian anchors psykanic perception across the operational area — eyes that do not blink, awareness that does not drift. What moves in the shadows, what hides in the warp-touched ruins, what the enemy thinks it conceals: the Librarian sees it and routes intelligence to where it is needed.

the_warding_field.name: The Warding Field
the_warding_field.description: The Librarian establishes a psykanic barrier around the company's positions. Not offensive capability — pure denial. What the warp sends, the Librarian turns away. The kill teams operate behind a barrier their enemy cannot understand how to breach.

the_breaking_word.name: The Breaking Word
the_breaking_word.description: A single concentrated psychic utterance that severs the command-link in the enemy's structure. Not individual combat — targeted disruption of the psychic or electromagnetic bonds that make the enemy a coherent force. They fragment; the Watch harvests the pieces.

deep_reading.name: Deep Reading
deep_reading.description: The Librarian dedicates this beat to thorough analysis of the psychic currents surrounding the current node. What has happened here, what is happening, what the warp intends — a comprehensive intelligence picture that supplements everything the Kill Team can observe directly.

the_psychic_lance.name: The Psychic Lance
the_psychic_lance.description: The Librarian identifies a single significant threat and prepares a focused psychic elimination. All psykanic resource is conserved and channelled to this one execution — singular, devastating, and absolute.

the_veil_pierced.name: The Veil Pierced
the_veil_pierced.description: The Librarian reaches through the warp's membrane and extracts specific knowledge — what lies at the node's heart, what the enemy intends at the strategic level, what the campaign's true shape is. Intelligence that no conventional means could reach.

the_memoria_bound.name: The Memoria Bound
the_memoria_bound.description: The Librarian inscribes this beat's significant events into the psychic chronicle — the immutable record maintained in the warp's own substrate. What is written here cannot be altered, cannot be suppressed. The truth is preserved regardless of what the campaign's record otherwise claims.

shatter_the_working.name: Shatter the Working
shatter_the_working.description: A specific enemy psychic operation has been identified — ritual, warding, compulsion, or presence. The Librarian dedicates everything to dismantling it. No other contribution this beat; the working is ended.

the_quiet_channel.name: The Quiet Channel
the_quiet_channel.description: The Librarian maintains a psychic communication network between kill teams that no signal-jam or vox disruption can interfere with. Whatever the electromagnetic environment does to conventional communications, the kill teams remain coordinated.

the_daemon_unmasked.name: The Daemon Unmasked
the_daemon_unmasked.description: The Librarian strips the glamours and concealment from warp-entities on this world, forcing their true nature into observable reality. What was hidden becomes visible; what was deniable becomes undeniable. The kill teams can now kill what they could previously only suspect.

castellan._description: The Castellan sets theatre-wide intelligence doctrine — an order that flows down to every Watch Keeper in the companies. As Chief Watch Keeper, he defines how the Watch knows what it knows. His log_text is the narrative anchor for beat chronicle generation.

theatre_intelligence.name: Theatre Intelligence
theatre_intelligence.description: The Castellan has the complete picture before anyone else does — threat dossiers, route analyses, weakness assessments for every threat on the committed node. No kill team moves without knowing what waits.

black_operations.name: Black Operations
black_operations.description: Pre-positioned assets activate. The Castellan had operations in motion before the cascade began — covert resources, placed agents, intelligence infrastructure already established on the committed node before the Watch officially arrives.

seal_the_reach.name: Seal the Reach
seal_the_reach.description: Strategic counterintelligence. The enemy learns nothing of the Watch's composition, timing, or objectives this beat. Theatre-wide information denial — the Watch moves in silence.

eyes_everywhere.name: Eyes Everywhere
eyes_everywhere.description: The Castellan deploys a network of surveillance assets across the committed node before the ops window opens. No enemy movement, no reinforcement, no retreat goes unobserved by the Watch's intelligence infrastructure.

cut_the_signal.name: Cut the Signal
cut_the_signal.description: Enemy communications and command-net targeted for systematic disruption. The Castellan's doctrine: before the kill teams move, the enemy cannot coordinate, cannot reinforce, cannot even confirm to their commanders that the Watch has arrived.

the_prepared_ground.name: The Prepared Ground
the_prepared_ground.description: Intelligence gathered. Contingencies placed. The Castellan has pre-positioned assets on the committed node before the cascade began — safe houses, observation points, cached equipment. The Watch arrives to a battlefield it already understands.

dossier_protocol.name: Dossier Protocol
dossier_protocol.description: Every identified hostile of interest receives a full threat dossier before kill teams deploy. Command structures, movement patterns, personal vulnerabilities — the Watch goes in with knowledge that should be impossible to have.

counterintelligence_lockdown.name: Counterintelligence Lockdown
counterintelligence_lockdown.description: The Castellan declares total information denial across the theatre. Enemy intelligence assets are identified, traced, and neutralised. The Watch operates in total secrecy — the enemy fights blind while the Watch sees everything.

first_light_analysis.name: First Light Analysis
first_light_analysis.description: The Castellan compiles a full strategic assessment of the committed node — pressure vectors, population centres of interest, terrain exploitation opportunities, enemy order-of-battle. Kill teams receive it before first contact.

ghost_protocol.name: Ghost Protocol
ghost_protocol.description: The Castellan erases the Watch's operational signature entirely. No record of deployment, no confirmed presence, no intelligence trail. What happened on this node this beat will never be attributable to the Watch.

threat_escalation_report.name: Threat Escalation Report
threat_escalation_report.description: The Castellan compiles and disseminates intelligence confirming this node's threat has escalated beyond previous assessments. Kill teams go in with accurate expectations — no false confidence, no operational shocks.

asset_recovery_mandate.name: Asset Recovery Mandate
asset_recovery_mandate.description: The Castellan identifies intelligence assets — agents, vaults, cogitator networks — on the committed node that must be recovered or destroyed before the enemy can exploit them. Kill teams operate with a dual mission.

know_your_enemy.name: Know Your Enemy
know_your_enemy.description: The Castellan prepares a complete xenological or tactical brief on the identified enemy — biology, psychology, command doctrine, known weaknesses. Kill teams fight what they understand, and understanding is the first step to killing.

watch_keeper._description: The Watch Keeper applies the Castellan's theatre intelligence doctrine at company level — how this company's intel specialist operates this beat. Shaped by Castellan strategic_intelligence above.

the_watchers_eye.name: The Watcher's Eye
the_watchers_eye.description: Complete situational awareness for this company. No enemy action in this company's operational zone goes unobserved — the Keeper knows what waits in every shadow before the kill teams step into it.

close_the_gates.name: Close the Gates
close_the_gates.description: Counterintelligence for this company. The Watch keeps its secrets; the enemy learns nothing about this company's movements or objectives. Every breach sealed, every leak cauterised.

the_shadow_war.name: The Shadow War
the_shadow_war.description: This company's Keeper had assets already in play — covert resources, pre-positioned contacts, contingencies the enemy cannot have anticipated at company scale.

the_record_unsealed.name: The Record Unsealed
the_record_unsealed.description: The Watch Keeper opens relevant xenos intelligence files to the kill teams — encounters, behavioural patterns, weaknesses confirmed by previous Watch operations. Brothers who know what they face kill it more efficiently.

the_silence_maintained.name: The Silence Maintained
the_silence_maintained.description: The Watch Keeper ensures operational security is absolute this beat — no intelligence leaks, no communications compromise, no indication to the enemy that the Watch is aware of their disposition. Information advantage is only valuable when the enemy does not know you have it.

cross_reference_active.name: Cross-Reference Active
cross_reference_active.description: The Watch Keeper analyses this beat's operational data against the Librarium's holdings — identifying patterns the kill teams may not see themselves. Tactical anomalies, strategic deceptions, threat signatures that match historical encounters. Nothing about this enemy is truly new.

the_sealed_account.name: The Sealed Account
the_sealed_account.description: The Watch Keeper creates a classified record of this beat's most sensitive intelligence — sealed, compartmentalised, accessible only to those with need and authorisation. Some truths are too dangerous to circulate freely.

identify_the_apex.name: Identify the Apex
identify_the_apex.description: The Watch Keeper directs intelligence efforts to profiling the enemy's most dangerous element — its leadership structure, its most capable warrior, its strategic centre of gravity. Intelligence precedes the blade; the Watch Keeper ensures the blade is aimed correctly.

the_cartographic_update.name: The Cartographic Update
the_cartographic_update.description: The Watch Keeper integrates this beat's reconnaissance into the operational map — confirmed routes, denied zones, objective locations updated, enemy dispositions refined. The map the kill teams use next beat will be better because of what was learned this one.

the_cipher_broken.name: The Cipher Broken
the_cipher_broken.description: Enemy communications captured this beat are fed through the Watch Keeper's analytical processes. The cipher broken, the signal traffic read, the enemy's plan understood before it is fully executed. The Watch Keeper's quiet work has wider consequences than most will know.

historical_precedent.name: Historical Precedent
historical_precedent.description: The Watch Keeper locates records of a previous Watch operation on this world or against this specific enemy configuration. Lessons from that campaign — what worked, what failed, what was learned at terrible cost — are shared with the company in time to be actionable.

the_tally_updated.name: The Tally Updated
the_tally_updated.description: Every kill confirmed, every objective secured, every intelligence asset recovered — the Watch Keeper maintains the operational accounting. This beat's tally matters because it feeds into the campaign's strategic assessment. Precision in record-keeping is its own form of mission-critical work.

threat_reclassification.name: Threat Reclassification
threat_reclassification.description: Based on evidence gathered this beat, the Watch Keeper formally revises the threat classification of the enemy force. Resources are reallocated, priorities are updated, the campaign's response is calibrated to what is actually present rather than what was assumed at the outset.

judiciar._description: The Judiciar's killing focus for the beat. KT-tier only. Influenced by faith_track (Watch Chaplain + High Chaplain) above. The Judiciar issues sentence before battle and prosecutes it personally.

tempormortis.name: Tempormortis
tempormortis.description: Time itself is the weapon. The Judiciar's blade slows the battlefield around one condemned target — the rest of the kill team works in the silence that creates.

sentence_passed.name: Sentence Passed
sentence_passed.description: Judgment is rendered before battle. The guilty are named; the Judiciar's arrival is not combat — it is an execution already decided, simply being carried out.

none_shall_pass.name: None Shall Pass
none_shall_pass.description: The Judiciar becomes the kill team's wall. No breach permitted. No enemy that reaches the brothers lives to take another step. The blade covers everything the kill team cannot watch.

the_sentence_pronounced.name: The Sentence Pronounced
the_sentence_pronounced.description: The Judiciar formally pronounces the kill team's mandate as irrevocable judgement — not an operation, not a mission, but a sentence already passed. The kill team executes what has already been decided in the Emperor's name.

no_appeal.name: No Appeal
no_appeal.description: The Judiciar removes the possibility of mercy from the kill team's doctrine. This target cannot be spared, cannot be captured, cannot be permitted to survive. The sentence is death and the Judiciar ensures every brother understands there are no alternatives.

the_law_applied.name: The Law Applied
the_law_applied.description: The Judiciar invokes the specific doctrinal framework — Codex clause, Chapter edict, or Deathwatch standing order — that governs this engagement's permissible methods. Clarity of mandate is the Judiciar's gift; the kill team knows exactly what the law requires.

guilt_confirmed.name: Guilt Confirmed
guilt_confirmed.description: The Judiciar has assessed the intelligence and confirmed the target's nature beyond dispute. No wasted operations against misidentified threats — the Judiciar's assessment gives the kill team absolute certainty about what they are killing and why.

tempus_mortis.name: Tempus Mortis
tempus_mortis.description: The Judiciar's temporal judgement weapon extends its influence — the kill team operates in the shadow of slowed time, striking with certainty while the enemy's reactions drag. The Judiciar manages the field's temporal character to ensure kills land before defences rise.

accountability_rendered.name: Accountability Rendered
accountability_rendered.description: The Judiciar ensures the company's own conduct is beyond reproach. Civilian protocols, rules of engagement, collateral assessment — the kill team operates within the law because the Judiciar holds them to it. The Watch does not become what it fights.

the_old_sentence.name: The Old Sentence
the_old_sentence.description: The Judiciar invokes a sentence passed long before this beat — an ancient mandate, a founding judgement, a standing order from decades prior that has never been rescinded. Whatever was decreed then governs now, and the Judiciar ensures it is honoured.

the_blade_consecrated.name: The Blade Consecrated
the_blade_consecrated.description: The Judiciar performs rites over the kill team's close-quarters weapons before deployment. Every blade is consecrated to specific use this beat — the kill that the Judiciar has ordained. The weapons are prepared for the work they were made for.

zero_clemency.name: Zero Clemency
zero_clemency.description: The Judiciar has reviewed the files and found no grounds for anything except total elimination. This is not aggression — it is adjudicated certainty. The kill team carries out what the evidence demands with complete moral clarity.

the_witness_stands.name: The Witness Stands
the_witness_stands.description: The Judiciar ensures this beat's most significant actions are formally witnessed and entered into the record. Whatever the kill team achieves or fails to achieve, it is attested — the Judiciar's testimony cannot be disputed.

dread_angle._description: The Dreadnought's angle for the beat — how the ancient warrior commits. Floating across both HC and Company tier. Does not gate cascade advance; contributes strats and terminus call regardless.

ancient_fury.name: Ancient Fury
ancient_fury.description: The ancient goes to war without reservation. Millennia of battle-hate focused to a single engagement — the Dreadnought is not a relic at this moment. It is a weapon.

iron_remembrance.name: Iron Remembrance
iron_remembrance.description: From the deep past, wisdom. The ancient warrior has seen this battle before — ten thousand years of pattern recognition turned toward a single beat. The counsel shapes the fight before a shot is fired.

the_last_wall.name: The Last Wall
the_last_wall.description: The Dreadnought holds the line. No position is taken while the ancient guardian stands before it. The kill teams fight behind something that does not break.

the_silence_before.name: The Silence Before
the_silence_before.description: The Dread Angel operates in total quiet before the strike. No contact, no communications, no announcement — and then complete violence from no direction the enemy could identify as the threat's origin. The kill is everything; the approach is nothing.

the_angle_known.name: The Angle Known
the_angle_known.description: The Dread Angel scouts the target's position, identifies the approach that no defender is watching, and commits to it at the moment the enemy's attention is elsewhere. Intelligence-driven assassination — not speed, but placement.

the_target_alone.name: The Target Alone
the_target_alone.description: The Dread Angel isolates the primary kill from the protective structure around it. Draw the guards away, collapse their cohesion, create the window — and in that window, the kill. Clean, certain, and impossible to defend against.

void_touched_hunt.name: Void-Touched Hunt
void_touched_hunt.description: The target is not entirely material. The Dread Angel adapts their approach for a quarry that exists partially in the warp — psyker, daemonhost, or entity that cannot be killed by standard means. The hunt is modified to address what the target actually is.

the_distance_closed.name: The Distance Closed
the_distance_closed.description: The Dread Angel accepts that the target is defended and plans for the closing movement regardless. Not stealth — direct approach under fire, movement too fast and too controlled for the defenders to effectively engage. The distance closes; the target dies.

the_faith_of_execution.name: The Faith of Execution
the_faith_of_execution.description: The kill is a sacred act. The Dread Angel approaches the target as a rite — preparation, consecration, execution performed in the correct sequence for a correct result. Faith informs technique; the Emperor's will guides the blade.

witnessed_only_in_death.name: Witnessed Only in Death
witnessed_only_in_death.description: The Dread Angel ensures the kill team has no observable presence until the moment of the strike. Every approach angle screened, every signature suppressed, every contingency planned so that the first the enemy knows of the kill team is the last thing they know at all.

the_blade_sufficient.name: The Blade Sufficient
the_blade_sufficient.description: The Dread Angel strips back the kill team's doctrine to a single focused question: is the blade sufficient? Everything reduced to the minimum required to make the kill — no excess, no distraction, no consideration beyond the act and its immediate requirements.

the_pattern_broken.name: The Pattern Broken
the_pattern_broken.description: The Dread Angel identifies the defensive routine around the target and acts in the gap between cycles — the moment the guards have just checked a position and won't check it again for a predictable interval. The window exists; the Dread Angel knows its length.

the_xenos_specifics.name: The Xenos Specifics
the_xenos_specifics.description: The Dread Angel researches the specific physiological vulnerabilities of the target species. Where it can be killed, how it can be killed, what it cannot survive — the hunt is built around eliminating exactly what the enemy is rather than applying generic doctrine to a specific threat.
