personal_focus._description: Battle-line personal focus pick. Presented AFTER the Watch Sergeant locks doctrine — choose where your personal oath is directed this cycle. Options are fixed; doctrine tags from above may shift the recommended choice, but all remain available.

honour_the_charge.name: Honour the Charge
honour_the_charge.description: Lead the assault. Personal excellence in direct engagement — the brother at the tip of the spear, holding the oath in both hands and driving it into the enemy.

brothers_keeper.name: Brother's Keeper
brothers_keeper.description: Watch the line. Cover brothers, hold the formation, ensure no one fights alone and no one falls unwitnessed. The kill team is the weapon — the Keeper keeps it whole.

blood_and_thunder.name: Blood and Thunder
blood_and_thunder.description: Relentless aggression. Hit first, hit hardest, keep striking until there is nothing left standing. The kill team is a weapon — be the sharpest edge of it.

patience_of_stone.name: Patience of Stone
patience_of_stone.description: Hold discipline. Do not overextend, do not expose. Ground won must be held; enemy ground must be denied without burning brothers to do it. The patient Astartes outlasts all opposition.

emperors_sight.name: The Emperor's Sight
emperors_sight.description: Eyes open, mouth ready. Mark what matters, call what the kill team needs to see, ensure no brother fights blind. Intelligence wins wars. Be the eyes.

unbroken_oath.name: Unbroken Oath
unbroken_oath.description: The oath holds when everything else breaks. If brothers fall, the mission does not. Endurance, sacrifice, the will to see it through regardless of cost — this is the final weapon.

the_enemy_studied.name: The Enemy Studied
the_enemy_studied.description: Before deployment this cycle, dedicate personal study to the specific enemy configuration faced at the current node. Kill zone preference, response patterns, command signals — knowledge that translates directly into kills.

the_armour_maintained.name: The Armour Maintained
the_armour_maintained.description: Perform the full armour rite cycle yourself rather than relying on Techmarine resources. Your ceramite is your responsibility and your investment — maximum integrity going into the cycle's operations.

the_blade_honed.name: The Blade Honed
the_blade_honed.description: Every weapon in your wargear brought to optimal condition by your own hand. Not maintenance — preparation with intent. The blade knows the work it is being prepared for.

witness_carried.name: Witness Carried
witness_carried.description: You volunteer to carry the kill team's documentation obligation personally this cycle — every confirmed kill, every significant event, every brother lost. The tally is yours to keep and the record will be accurate.

the_oath_specific.name: The Oath Specific
the_oath_specific.description: You swear a personal oath tied to this cycle's specific objective — not general excellence, but a precise commitment with a concrete success condition. The oath creates accountability; accountability creates performance.

fire_discipline_perfect.name: Fire Discipline Perfect
fire_discipline_perfect.description: You hold your own fire until the moment is certain — no wasted ammunition, no suppression that achieves nothing, no engagement without a kill. Your personal output this cycle is entirely composed of kills.

the_void_endured.name: The Void Endured
the_void_endured.description: Exposure to warp influence is acknowledged rather than suppressed. You do not fight what you have absorbed — you hold it, understand it, and ensure it serves the mission rather than compromising you. The void is your territory, not your enemy.

silence_as_doctrine.name: Silence as Doctrine
silence_as_doctrine.description: You commit to maintaining absolute operational quiet this cycle — no unnecessary transmissions, no announced positions, no communications that do not directly serve the mission. Your personal signature in this operation is zero.

the_kill_clean.name: The Kill Clean
the_kill_clean.description: Your focus is singular: one primary target, engaged and eliminated with minimum time and maximum certainty. No secondary engagements distract from the kill. You are the blade for one specific purpose this cycle.

_track_map._note: Maps canonical rank names (from rank_mappings.json) to their cascade_options section key. Each role has its own section. Influence flow between tiers (e.g. Forgemaster shapes Watch Techmarine's weights) is in rank_mappings.json influence_sources.track.
